title: Redact PDF: Black Out Text for Good, Free, No Upload
description: Redact PDF files in your browser: black out text or areas, and the words are removed from the file, then checked. Free, nothing is uploaded.
promise: Redact PDF text and areas so the words are gone from the file, not just covered. Before you download, the finished file is searched to make sure. Everything runs on your device.

app.name: Redact PDF
featureList: Black out selected text or any area of a page
Text under the marks is removed from the page, not covered
Redacted words are also removed from properties, bookmarks and attachments
The finished file is searched for every redacted phrase before download
Runs in the browser, nothing is uploaded
